scripts.test:built: node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-auth-build.mjs
scripts.dev:collector: npm run generate && node --env-file=.env --import tsx apps/api/src/collector-main.ts
scripts.test:extension: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-extension.ts
scripts.dev:private: npm run generate && node --env-file=.env --import tsx apps/api/src/private-main.ts
scripts.test:private-extension: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-extension.ts --private
scripts.test:auth: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-auth.ts
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-mobile.ts
scripts.test:reliability: npm run check && node --import tsx scripts/verify-extension.ts --private && node --import tsx scripts/verify-auth.ts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-mobile.ts
